label: context.reference
text:
Create images through world_image_generation. Send artifact.send to world_image_generation, label image.generation.request, payload {"prompt": "..."}; optional "size" (for example "1024x1024" or "1536x1024") and "model" override the configured defaults.

The interface answers with the generated image as an image.generated artifact followed by image.generate.result: ok, revised_prompt and the image artifact reference. When generation fails, image.generate.result carries ok false and error.class and error.detail. Describe the image to the user only after the result arrived.
